Name: I Hate Flower Colors (Vibrant Flowers Mod)
Description:
This mod makes colored flowers look prettier with bright colors. Uses Content Patcher and Alternative Textures--which means you can use the AT Paint Bucket item to change your flower colors as well.

Flowers will produce only the default color of item with this mod installed. So, you will only have one color of Tulip items, one color of Poppy items, etc. ([i]Note: After installation, any existing flowers will still produce "colored" flowers when picked. Newly planted flowers will behave correctly.[/i])

Compatibility for [b]Cornucopia[/b] flowers will be added in the near future.

[b][i][color=#e06666]I will not add compatibility for any other modded flowers or flower retextures. Please do not make any requests, as this is an issue with art permissions and not something I can control.
